title: Names in the kernel
hints: Check the most specific prefixes first: `\\?\UNC\` before `\\?\`, and `\\?\` and `\\.\` before the plain `\\` of a UNC path.
requirements: Device, link and user-mode names are built only from valid base names.
Win32 paths convert to NT paths and back for drive, UNC, device and long-path forms.
The service name and the user-visible registry path come out of a driver's registry path in any letter case.
stretch: Add `\GLOBAL??\` (the global object directory that `\??\` falls back to) and per-session device maps, and a function that lists, for a base name, everything a driver must create and delete, in the order it must do it.
